scope.summary: Scripts, plugins, and model lanes address document objects by the stable prefixed canonical ids (e.g. SLYR-*) and MAY attach operator-assigned string labels for intent-based lookup (deduped script-label facility). Object addressing MUST NOT depend on layer position, name text, or z-order alone, so a macro/plugin re-run resolves the same object deterministically.
acceptance_criteria: stable-id + label addressing; position/name/z-order-only rejected; deterministic re-run
expected_tests: test: object resolves by prefixed id + by attached label deterministically
negative: resolution by position/name/z-order-only is rejected
live: macro re-run resolves same object after reorder

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Addressing objects by id and label (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Macro/plugin re-runs target wrong objects after reorder; non-deterministic automation.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
